prompt: How old was the United States Air Force when the 317th Fighter-Interceptor Squadron was inactivated, rounded to the nearest year?
answer: The U.S. Air Force was established on **September 18, 1947**. When the 317th Fighter-Interceptor Squadron was inactivated on **December 31, 1969**, the Air Force was about **22 years old**.
